title: Seoul shares dip over 3% on tech sell-off amid AI concerns
caption:
South Korean markets saw a sharp downturn as semiconductor giants faced a massive sell-off. Investors are re-evaluating the long-term sustainability of AI-focused investments after disappointing earnings reports.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul shares dip over 3% on tech sell-off amid AI concerns
